title: D-ID Launches Presentation Mode, Turning Static Slide Decks into Interactive AI Conversations
summary: D-ID Presentation Mode turns any slide deck into a live AI presentation that viewers can interrupt and question. Try the demo.
body_markdown:
[D-ID](https://www.d-id.com/) , a leader in enterprise-grade AI avatar solutions, announced today the launch of its latest feature, Presentation Mode, which turns any slide deck into an interactive presentation led by a real-time AI Agent. Viewers can interrupt at any point, ask questions, and get answers on the spot, while the Agent keeps the presentation on track.


Presentation Mode builds on D-ID‚Äôs V4 Expressive Avatar Agents and Agentic Videos, expanding D-ID‚Äôs capabilities from passive content to interactive, conversational experiences. With Presentation Mode, a presentation no longer requires a live presenter. Instead, every viewer gets an AI presenter that can deliver the material and respond to questions in real time.


**Instead of reading about this one, go talk to it.** D-ID has created a Presentation Mode Agent that presents Presentation Mode itself. Visitors can interrupt the demo, ask questions about how it works, and experience the feature first-hand.


[Talk to the Presentation Mode demo](https://www.d-id.com/presentation-mode/)


Presentation Mode includes four core capabilities:


- **Interactive presentations:** Viewers can interrupt the Agent at any time, ask questions, and explore the topics that matter to them. The Agent answers their questions, and then picks up where it left off.
- **Automatic speaker notes:** Users can upload a PDF or PowerPoint file, or share a public Google Slides link, for decks up to 100 slides or 100 MB. D-ID generates the speaker notes for every slide. No scripting, recording, or rehearsal is required.
- **Full Agent customization:** Presentation Mode runs on standard D-ID Agents, with the same avatar, voice, and language options. Creators can set the audience, goal, pacing, check-in style and tone. For example, they can instruct the Agent to ask for questions every third slide. The Agent can also begin presenting automatically when a session starts.
- **Audience insights:** Every session is saved with a full transcript on the Agent‚Äôs Insights page in D-ID Studio, including every question asked and every answer given. Conversations can be exported as a CSV and shared with teammates via a link.


> ‚Many presentations today are sent, not presented, which means the audience doesn‚Äôt always have an opportunity to ask questions. Presentation Mode gives every deck a presenter that can respond in real time. It turns a one-way presentation into an interactive experience, while giving teams greater insight into what their audiences want to know.‚
>
>
> Gil Perry, CEO and Co-Founder of D-ID


Presentation Mode is designed for teams that rely on presentations to inform, sell, and train, including:


- **Sales:** Prospects can explore pitch decks on their own time and get answers to their questions, while sales teams see what they asked before the next call.
- **Product marketing:** Product launches and feature walkthroughs that let buyers explore the details most relevant to their needs.
- **Training and onboarding:** Self-paced learning that allows employees to ask questions rather than simply watch.
- **Internal communications:** Strategy updates and all-hands content that employees can question, not just watch.


Presentation Mode is now available and is not limited to a specific D-ID plan. To experience it, visit[d-id.com/interactive-presentations/](https://www.d-id.com/interactive-presentations/) and talk to the live demo, or upload your own deck to create an interactive presentation.
